comment: Written by generators/senses (rfc3339cases) from RFC 3339 section 5.8 at its pinned bytes (app/specs/standards/texts/9ab2b8864a85dca73a88f49b0927bc7bc85f596926e4fd1890905777924e700a): do not edit. Each example is a request of the rfc3339 guest and its answer as the section itself tells it: an example already in UTC is its own UTC form; the example the section calls equivalent to a date-time in UTC has that as its UTC form; the two examples it calls the same leap second are the same instant.
